mapper.select: SELECT VERSION_ID as versionId, VERSION_NO as versionNo, VERSION_NAME as versionName, VERSION_TYPE as versionType, VERSION_STATUS as versionStatus, CHANGE_DESCRIPTION as changeDescription, CHANGE_TYPE as changeType, IS_CURRENT as isCurrent, IS_PUBLISHED as isPublished, PUBLISH_TIME as publishTime, PUBLISH_BY_NAME as publishByName, CREATOR_NAME as creatorName, CREATE_TIME as createTime FROM TBL_BUDGET_MODEL_VERSION WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
